summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park; homes 13-25 m away, steep.

drivers.seclusion: Homes sit 13-25 m from the kerb on this side and across the road; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane; cars and a van-sized vehicle park along it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, no through traffic.
drivers.convention: Other cars park here, but the street is residential with No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri signs.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade, max 14.8% on the whole stretch
Signs: No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri, and Any Time near one end
Low-lying at the bottom end (6 m elevation)
sun_shade: Mixed; street trees shade parts, open from the west in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to overnight vans

best_section.where: West kerb of Sundridge Street, about 100 m up from the Seven Oaks end, beside the apartment block
